Definition: properly, eaten, i.e. food; also flesh, i.e. body
BiblicalUsage: Flesh or food is the word for what is eaten and for the body itself, and both appearances are judgments. In Job 20:23 God will rain His wrath on the wicked "while he is eating," and in Zephaniah 1:17 the sinners' "flesh" shall be poured out as dung in the day of the Lord.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the word's two uses are one warning: the food in the mouth and the flesh on the body are both under God's hand, and neither is safe in the day of His anger.
